ppsc.source_notes:
Sources: FlowRecordUpdate.updateAccount1001_Positive,
FlowRecordUpdate.updateAccount1001_Negative, FlowRecordUpdate.Update_Account_1007_Positive,
FlowRecordUpdate.Update_Account_1007_Negative, FlowFormula.formAgeCalculation.

Flow updates rows 14488,14490,14503,14504 -> Account.Age_at_Time_of_Consent__pc.

Both primary-consent branches and both assent branches assign the translated
FlowFormula.Age_At_Execution value. Other routes retain the Account BEFORE value. This is
execution-date age.

expectations.description: Observed Account.Age_at_Time_of_Consent__pc equals its expected AFTER value.

ppsc.source_notes:
Sources: FlowRecordUpdate.updateAccount1001_Positive,
FlowRecordUpdate.updateAccount1001_Negative, FlowRecordUpdate.Update_Account_1007_Positive,
FlowRecordUpdate.Update_Account_1007_Negative, FlowRecordLookup.Get_Permission_1007.

Rows 14488,14490,14503,14504 -> Account.CABOR_Completion_Date__c.

Primary uses Record.California_Signature__c; assent uses the 1007 lookup's
California_Signature__c, including an assigned NULL when no permission exists. An unordered
multi-match also returns NULL, distinguished by the output flag.

expectations.description: Observed Account.CABOR_Completion_Date__c equals its expected AFTER value.

ppsc.source_notes:
Sources: FlowRecordUpdate.updateAccount1001_Negative,
FlowRecordUpdate.Update_Account_1007_Negative.

Rows 14490,14504 -> Account.Earliest_Primary_Consent_Date_for_Report__c.

FlowRecordUpdate.Primary_Consent_With_Prior_Yes writes the triggering completion timestamp
when another Yes primary consent exists.
FlowRecordUpdate.Assent_With_Permission_Or_Primary_Date also writes the triggering
timestamp. Positive branches leave this field unchanged. This is the authored assignment,
not MIN(consent timestamps).

expectations.description: Observed Account.Earliest_Primary_Consent_Date_for_Report__c equals its expected AFTER value.

ppsc.source_notes:
Sources: FlowRecordUpdate.updateAccount1001_Positive,

FlowRecordUpdate.Update_Account_1007_Negative.

Rows 14488,14490,14503,14504 -> Account.Latest_Primary_Consent_Date_for_Report__c.

Both primary-consent and assent routes assign Record.Completion_Status_Timestamp__c. Lineage
is the triggering record, not MAX of all participant completion dates.

expectations.description: Observed Account.Latest_Primary_Consent_Date_for_Report__c equals its expected AFTER value.
